comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67, with the menu wording read verbatim out of TehomWidget::appendContextMenu and its four lambdas. Two parameters, X Position and Y Position, have no widget on the panel because the XY pad is one display rather than a pair of knobs, so they get no line; the pad is reached with the mouse and by the X CV and Y CV jacks. Tehom::process is the largest function in the plugin and was not read through, so the control lines describe what each control is for from the maker's own names and the panel, without quoting figures. Four more parameters, ids 27 to 30, have widgets at the top of each channel block but no name from the maker and no behaviour that could be traced out of Tehom::process; they are left untagged rather than described from guesswork. The four SPEED CV jacks are one octave per volt, clamped between log2(0.05) and 1, not a tenth of the knob per volt as first read; the record and play jacks read 1V, not 0.5V. The right audio input is normalled to the left.
